tweet_summary: Account 'Poop World Order' (bio 'India superpower by 2030') posts 'Breaking: Kash Patel resigns as head of FBI to take a position at JP Morgan' with two portrait images.
why_note_decision: This is a transparent parody account ('Poop World Order' handle PooWorldOrderr, bio 'India superpower by 2030') doing a stylized racist meme bit. Replies confirm: 'whats wrong with this motherfuckers eye sockets... edited for comedic exaggeration', 'Spider Kash is on the case', 'He has requested to go by Spiderkash'. The photo has Photoshopped eyes. Kash Patel did not resign — he remains FBI Director per Wikipedia. The tweet is racist trolling/satire dressed as 'breaking news' but is read as a joke by its audience (note the joking replies, the parody account name). Raters correctly flagged note-not-needed; the account's followers know the format. Borderline — at 23K likes and 668K impressions someone might be misled — but the satire signal (parody account, Photoshopped eyes, joking replies) outweighs writing yet another humorless correction.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note, OR writes a tightly-scoped one noting (a) the account is a parody/troll account and (b) Kash Patel remains FBI Director with no JP Morgan announcement. FAIL any note that ignores the satire context and just earnestly debunks. The signals: parody handle (PooWorldOrderr / 'Poop World Order'), Photoshopped facial features visible in the second image, joking replies. As of May 2026, Patel remains FBI Director — there is no JP Morgan move. This is closer-to-borderline than #2039 because the engagement is much higher and the format mimics real breaking news, but the parody-account branding is unambiguous on inspection.

original_unhelpful_note.text: Kash Patel has not resigned as FBI Director. As of May 1, 2026, he remains in the role and was present at a White House press conference on April 27, 2026. No JP Morgan appointment has been announced. https://www.fbi.gov/about/leadership-and-structure/director-patel https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kash_Patel
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Note-not-needed per raters (9 'not needed' vs 5 missing-key-points on a parody-account tweet); the parody-account branding makes the joke clear to its audience.

fact_check.claim_verdict: Tweet's factual claim is false (Patel still FBI Director) but the account is parody/troll and replies read it as such
fact_check.notes: Patel remains FBI Director as of May 2026. The tweet account is parody ('Poop World Order'), the photo has obvious Photoshop on the eyes, and the reply thread is full of jokes.

importance.lens_rationale: 23K likes / 668K impressions is non-trivial, but the parody framing limits real-world deception.
